resources.string:
Your words. Your key.

Enable Gachlagan, then select it as your keyboard. Open the keyboard’s settings to set a shared key.

Write in the visible Private draft and tap Encrypt & insert. Copy a received encrypted message to read it inside the keyboard.

Everything happens on this device. Binary, hex, octal, Base64 and Morse are public encodings, not private encryption. Share encryption keys in person. There is no key recovery.
